question: Ozone protects the Earth from ________ radiation of the sun.
solution:
The correct answer is __**ultraviolet**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ozone layer** is a thin part of the Earth's atmosphere that absorbs almost all of the sun's harmful **ultraviolet (UV) radiation**.
 
• It is primarily found in the lower portion of the **stratosphere**, approximately **15 to 35 kilometers** above Earth's surface.
 
• The ozone molecule is made up of **three oxygen atoms (O3)**, which are formed when **UV light** hits ordinary oxygen molecules (O2) and splits them into individual atoms that then combine with other O2 molecules.
 
• By absorbing **UV-B** and **UV-C** radiation, the ozone layer prevents these high-energy rays from reaching the ground, where they could cause **skin cancer**, **cataracts**, and damage to **DNA** in humans and animals.
 
• It also plays a crucial role in protecting **phytoplankton** and **terrestrial plants**, which are the base of the food chain and sensitive to intense radiation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The Montreal Protocol:**
 
 
• This is an international treaty signed in **1987** to protect the ozone layer by phasing out the production of numerous substances responsible for **ozone depletion**.
 
• The main chemicals targeted are **Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs)** and **Halons**, which were commonly used in refrigeration and aerosol sprays.
 
 
 
• **Measurement of Ozone:**
 
 
• The concentration of ozone in the atmosphere is measured in **Dobson Units (DU)**.
 
• A "hole" in the ozone layer is technically defined as an area where the concentration drops below **220 Dobson Units**.
 
 
 
• **Types of Radiation:**
 
 
• **Infrared (IR) Radiation:** These are **long-wavelength** rays that are mostly experienced as **heat**; they are absorbed by greenhouse gases like carbon dioxide.
 
• **Gamma Rays:** These are extremely **high-frequency** electromagnetic bursts that are typically blocked by the Earth's upper atmosphere (thermosphere).
 
• **Cosmic Rays:** These are high-energy particles originating from outside the solar system, largely diverted by the Earth's **magnetic field (magnetosphere)**.
 
 
 
• **World Ozone Day:**
 
 
• The United Nations General Assembly designated **September 16** as the International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Formation:** Ozone is naturally produced through the **photochemical reaction** known as the **Chapman Cycle**.
 
• **Location:** While **stratospheric ozone** is beneficial (protecting life), **ground-level ozone** (tropospheric ozone) is a pollutant and a primary component of **smog**.
 
• **Recent Trends:** Due to the success of the **Montreal Protocol**, the ozone layer is currently **healing** and is expected to return to **1980 levels** by the mid-21st century.
